independentOracle.separation: Expected coordinates are hand-authored literals plus rational arithmetic in a Python standard-library helper. No Farfold coordinate/anchor helper, PDF.js PageViewport, image decoder output or browser DOM is imported as expected truth. Real pixels later independently identify the colored feature; renderer dimensions/transforms are observations, not the oracle.

pdf.proposedFixtureNotYetCreated: Four font-free pages with identical asymmetric colored marks; MediaBox [0,0,420,640], CropBox [40,70,340,570], Rotate 0/90/180/270. A second bounded unit=2 variant or page ensures uniform unit scaling cancels from normalized coordinates. Page outside-crop marks visibly absent.
pdf.rawAxes: PDF x right/y up; u=(x-40)/300, v=(y-70)/500; transform all four corners then bound.
discriminators: Crop origin is nonzero and differs on x/y; selecting the mark using MediaBox must fail the expected rectangle.
Non-square feature and four different corner colors distinguish rotation from mirror, width/height swap and Y flip.
UserUnit changes physical/backing size, never normalized target; do not assert exact canvas pixels where bounded render scale/ceil legitimately changes them.
After page change/restore clamp, target page is successfully displayed actual page; same-size pages must not share a frame lease.

image.proposedFixtureNotYetCreated: One authored 320x200 asymmetric raster with unique corner colors and an off-centre marked rectangle. PNG baseline plus JPEG tag1..8 sharing the same encoded raster orientation; generate only into a new owned fixture directory after thaw, retain writer/version/hash.
image.rawAxes: u=x/320, v=y/200, x right/y down. Pixel region is a continuous edge rectangle, not centre-index coordinates.
discriminators: Do not assume naturalWidth/Height alone proves mirror orientation: tags1..4 have identical dimensions.
Use interior pixel color samples and visibly asymmetric marker. JPEG pixel oracle permits explicit color tolerance away from edges, while rational anchor expectations remain exact.
A browser that does not honor a fixture orientation must produce a recorded compatibility failure, not rewritten expected coordinates.
Reuse old EXIF materials only by immutable copy/reference; never regenerate prior frozen fixtures.

cssDprLetterbox.qualification: This padded/contain arrangement is an adversarial geometry model, not a claim current CSS uses object-fit. Current intrinsic img/canvas boxes must be measured as actually implemented; any future object-fit stage must exclude its bars.
rules: Pointer clientX/clientY and getBoundingClientRect share viewport CSS units. Never multiply pointer offsets by DPR or divide by backing-store canvas.width.

DPR1/1.25/2, rendered CSS width257.5 and fractional left/top must preserve the same normalized feature. Requesting DPR on a test context is not evidence: record actual window.devicePixelRatio and backing/CSS dimensions.
Start in padding/letterbox/border produces no candidate. White/transparent pixels inside actual image content remain valid image area; do not infer content boundaries from alpha/color.

Page scroll between separate selections does not change normalized geometry. Scroll/resize/layout shift during an active drag must invalidate or use an explicitly frozen/rechecked box, never blend pointer positions from two layouts.
Candidate from old dimensions/resize/new draw cannot confirm even if same file/page and identical pixel dimensions recur.

quantizationDecisionBeforeTests.status: recommendation requiring owner agreement, not yet a product contract
quantizationDecisionBeforeTests.recommended: Normalize reverse pointer corners in real CSS fractions, clamp only the end of a drag that began inside; round each edge to nearest integer millionth with ties upward for nonnegative values. Reject if rounding collapses width/height; never silently inflate. Numeric percent input should map exactly with at most four decimal places (0.0001 percent = 1 millionth) and reject rather than round excess precision.
cases: inverted numeric rectangle rejected; reverse pointer gesture normalized
quantizationDecisionBeforeTests.why: Freeze rounding and pointer-edge inclusion before implementation-based assertions, so an independent test cannot rationalize changed expected coordinates.
